Name: (CP) Horse Flute Looks Like A Normal Flute
Author: addioangel
Description:
The flute is colored to match the scheme of my current game so it's a bit de-saturated.
If there's any recolor you'd like, feel free to request it!

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
1- Download the main mod + any external mods it may require
2- Extract the files to your mods folder
3- Finished!

[b]Requirements[/b]
This is a Content Patcher mod, it will not work without Content Patcher.
